drivingQuestion: At which moment is a person's wealth measured for the valuation he owes?
outcomeNote: A mishna: the anonymous ruling and R' Yehuda's extension stand side by side with no adjudication here.

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הָיָה עָנִי וְהֶעֱשִׁיר, עָשִׁיר וְהֶעֱנִי — נוֹתֵן עֵרֶךְ עָשִׁיר. רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר: עָנִי וְהֶעֱשִׁיר וְחָזַר וְהֶעֱנִי — נוֹתֵן עֵרֶךְ עָשִׁיר.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» If when one took a vow of valuation «he was destitute and he became wealthy,» or if «he was wealthy and became destitute, he gives the valuation» in accordance with the means of «a wealthy person. Rabbi Yehuda says:» This is the halakha not only in a case where one was wealthy either at the time he took the vow or at the time of payment; even if when one took a vow of valuation «he was destitute and he became wealthy and again became destitute, he gives» the «valuation» in accordance with the means of «a wealthy person.»

segments.he: אֲבָל בַּקׇּרְבָּנוֹת אֵינוֹ כֵּן, אֲפִילּוּ מֵת אָבִיו וְהִנִּיחַ לוֹ רִיבּוֹא, אוֹ סְפִינָתוֹ בַּיָּם וּבָאָה לוֹ בְּרִבּוֹאוֹת — אֵין לַהֶקְדֵּשׁ בָּהּ כְּלוּם.
segments.en: «But with regard to» the «offerings» of a leper «that is not so,» as the offerings that one brings are determined by his status at the time he brings them. «Even» if it is common knowledge that «his father died and left him» an inheritance of «ten thousand» dinars, «or» that «his ship is at sea and» merchandise valued at «ten thousand» dinars «is coming into his» possession, «the Temple» treasury «has no» share «in it.» His payment is determined solely by his present situation.

moves.summary: one who was destitute and became wealthy, or the reverse, pays a wealthy person's valuation
moves.about: whether one who vowed while destitute, became wealthy and then became destitute again pays the valuation of a wealthy person

moves.summary: extends the rule to one wealthy only in the interim
moves.about: extending the anonymous rule that a wealthy man's valuation is owed to a case where wealth was held only in the interim

moves.summary: offerings follow present means, so prospective wealth is disregarded
